title: pages.comment.add
description: Add a comment anchored to a block or page: open a new thread (omit thread_id) or reply within an existing one. Thread and comment ids are minted deterministically by the docs-harness module.

target.description: The block or page id the comment (or its thread) is anchored to.

thread_id.description: Existing thread to reply in; omit to open a new thread on the target.

text.$comment: maxLength counts Unicode code points (JSON Schema semantics); the docs-harness module enforces MAX_COMMENT_TEXT_BYTES (4096 UTF-8 bytes) instead. Multi-byte text can pass this schema check and still be rejected by the module — the module is the stricter, authoritative bound, and that rejection is a clean probe reject, not a bug.
